recapture.en: The photograph helped her recapture the feeling of that summer trip.
recapture.zh: 那張照片幫助她重新找回那趟暑假旅行的感受。

recollect.en: I can recollect the main points of yesterday's discussion.
recollect.zh: 我還記得昨天討論的主要重點。

reconstruction.en: The museum displays a reconstruction of the ancient village.
reconstruction.zh: 博物館展示了古代村落的重建模型。

redundant.en: The editor removed redundant sentences from the final draft.
redundant.zh: 編輯從定稿中刪除了多餘的句子。

reel.en: The old film reel was stored carefully in the archive.
reel.zh: 那卷老電影膠卷被小心存放在檔案室。

refrain.en: Please refrain from talking while the recording is being made.
refrain.zh: 錄音進行時請避免交談。

regain.en: The team worked steadily to regain confidence after the loss.
regain.zh: 球隊在輸掉比賽後穩定努力以重拾信心。

rehabilitation.en: The city approved a rehabilitation project for the old railway station.
rehabilitation.zh: 市府核准了舊火車站的整修計畫。

rein.en: The rider held the rein loosely while the horse walked slowly.
rein.zh: 馬慢慢行走時，騎士輕輕握著韁繩。

relinquish.en: He agreed to relinquish his role after the new leader was chosen.
relinquish.zh: 新領導人選出後，他同意卸下自己的職務。

relish.en: Many students relish the chance to work on creative projects.
relish.zh: 許多學生很享受參與創意專題的機會。

reluctantly.en: She reluctantly agreed to change the plan after further discussion.
reluctantly.zh: 進一步討論後，她勉強同意更改計畫。

remains.en: The museum protects the remains of an ancient stone wall.
remains.zh: 博物館保護著一面古老石牆的遺跡。

reminiscence.en: His short reminiscence described childhood summers in the countryside.
reminiscence.zh: 他的短篇回憶描述了童年在鄉間度過的夏天。

renaissance.en: The class studied art produced during the renaissance in Europe.
renaissance.zh: 班上研究歐洲文藝復興時期的藝術作品。

reorganization.en: The club announced a reorganization of its committees this semester.
reorganization.zh: 社團宣布本學期將重新調整各委員會。

repel.en: The coating helps repel water from the surface of the fabric.
repel.zh: 這層塗料有助於讓水不易附著在布料表面。

repent.en: The character begins to repent after recognizing the harm he caused.
repent.zh: 角色在意識到自己造成的傷害後開始悔悟。

replaceable.en: Most parts in this model are replaceable if they wear out.
replaceable.zh: 這個模型的大多數零件磨損後都可以更換。

repress.en: Trying to repress every emotion can make communication more difficult.
repress.zh: 試圖壓抑所有情緒可能讓溝通變得更困難。

resonance.en: The experiment demonstrated resonance using a vibrating string and sound.
resonance.zh: 實驗利用振動的弦與聲音展示共振現象。

resultant.en: The resultant pattern was different from what the group predicted.
resultant.zh: 最後產生的圖樣與小組預測的不同。

rhythmic.en: The drummer kept a steady rhythmic pattern throughout the performance.
rhythmic.zh: 鼓手在整場演出中維持穩定的節奏型態。

righteous.en: The novel questions whether righteous intentions always lead to good outcomes.
righteous.zh: 小說探討正義的動機是否一定會帶來好的結果。

rite.en: The documentary describes a traditional rite practiced by the community.
rite.zh: 紀錄片描述該社群的一項傳統儀式。

robin.en: A robin landed on the fence outside the classroom window.
robin.zh: 一隻知更鳥停在教室窗外的籬笆上。

satire.en: The article explains how satire can criticize society through humor.
satire.zh: 文章說明諷刺作品如何透過幽默批評社會。

satisfactorily.en: The machine performed satisfactorily during the final round of testing.
satisfactorily.zh: 這台機器在最後一輪測試中表現令人滿意。

saturday.en: The school library will open for three hours on saturday.
saturday.zh: 學校圖書館星期六將開放三小時。

scarlet.en: A scarlet flower stood out among the green leaves.
scarlet.zh: 一朵鮮紅色的花在綠葉中格外醒目。

scholastic.en: The award recognizes strong scholastic achievement and community service.
scholastic.zh: 這個獎項表揚優秀的學業成就與社區服務。

seam.en: A small tear appeared along the seam of the bag.
seam.zh: 袋子的接縫處出現了一道小裂口。

secular.en: The course compares secular institutions with religious organizations historically.
secular.zh: 這門課從歷史角度比較世俗機構與宗教組織。

seemingly.en: The seemingly simple puzzle required several careful steps to solve.
seemingly.zh: 這道看似簡單的謎題其實需要幾個仔細步驟才能解開。

segregate.en: The science activity asked students to segregate materials by type.
segregate.zh: 科學活動要求學生依類型將材料分類。

sensibility.en: Her design shows a strong sensibility for balance and proportion.
sensibility.zh: 她的設計展現出對平衡與比例的良好感受力。

separately.en: Please submit the two forms separately before the deadline.
separately.zh: 請在截止日前分開提交這兩份表格。

september.en: The new semester usually begins in september at this school.
september.zh: 這所學校的新學期通常在九月開始。

sequential.en: The instructions present the experiment in a clear sequential order.
sequential.zh: 說明以清楚的順序呈現實驗步驟。

seven.en: There are seven chapters in the first section of the book.
seven.zh: 這本書的第一部分共有七章。

seventeen.en: Seventeen students volunteered to help with the school event.
seventeen.zh: 有十七名學生自願協助校內活動。

seventy.en: The survey received seventy complete responses by Friday afternoon.
seventy.zh: 到星期五下午，這份調查收到七十份完整回覆。

severely.en: Heavy rain severely delayed transportation across the region.
severely.zh: 大雨嚴重延誤了該地區的交通。

sewer.en: The city replaced an old sewer beneath the main road.
sewer.zh: 市府更換了主要道路下方的一條老舊下水道。

solely.en: The decision was not based solely on the final exam score.
solely.zh: 這項決定並不是只依據期末考成績。

solicitor.en: The article explains the role of a solicitor in British law.
solicitor.zh: 文章說明律師在英國法律制度中的角色。

spectacles.en: He placed his spectacles beside the book before going to sleep.
spectacles.zh: 他睡前把眼鏡放在書旁邊。

spectra.en: The physics class compared spectra produced by different light sources.
spectra.zh: 物理課比較不同光源產生的光譜。

sprawl.en: The map shows how urban sprawl changed the edge of the city.
sprawl.zh: 地圖顯示都市擴張如何改變城市邊緣。

squarely.en: The responsibility falls squarely on the committee that approved the plan.
squarely.zh: 責任明確落在批准該計畫的委員會身上。
